text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking by the academy gate after
classes
when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, classes are over! Time for some

karaoke! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a moment, Palmer? You
appear to
be... unwell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are you talking about? I feel
awesome!
Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You can't pull the wool over my eyes.
You should
stay in today and rest up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Umm, but I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is there some reason you absolutely
need to go to
karaoke?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You sure are perceptive, huh, Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the whole idea of today's
karaoke
meetup is to cheer up this one
student who lost a
race recently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be good for her to just stay
mopey
forever, right? That's why I
wanted to help get her
back on track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's all the more reason not to go.
Have you
thought about what would
happen if you were to
make her sick
too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And even if you feel fine now, it's not
uncommon
for people to break out into
a fever at night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, fine...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll go to karaoke in your stead and take
it upon
myself to enliven the
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Say what now?! I totally need to see that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, what you need is to go to bed and
rest. And
don't forget to stay hydrated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you start to feel any chills coming on,
it means
your fever is worsening, so try
to stay warm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Conversely, if you grow too hot, be sure
to wipe
away any sweat and change into
lighter clothing
so your body heat can
escape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While watching the two of them—Ardan
readily
giving advice, and Palmer
listening quietly—I
suddenly blurt out...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While watching the two of them—Ardan
readily
giving advice, and Palmer
listening quietly—I
suddenly blurt out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you for the compliment. I
suppose
it's due to having a wealth of
experience with this
sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Though that's not really something to
boast
about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all! Everything you
told me is
gonna be a massive help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I do hope so. Never hesitate to come to
me if
you're feeling under the weather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks! I'll show you I can outrun
this
sickness, no sweat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And once I've recovered, we can
celebrate with a
round of karaoke,
Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Certainly. Let's make it a rousing time. I
shall
show you just how brilliantly I
shine. ♪
